info.title: Smart Campaign Composer API
info.description:
The JSON API behind the web app: sign in, turn a brief into audience rules, write and review messages per language, approve, then follow delivery live.

**Authentication.** `POST /api/login` sets the `scc_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 12 hours from sign-in, no renewal). Every other `/api/` route needs it and answers `401` without it. In this page, sign in with *Try it out* on `/api/login`; the browser then sends the cookie with the other calls.

**Writes from browsers** (POST, PUT, DELETE) must come from this site's own pages: a request with another site's `Origin` header gets `403`.

**Errors** are JSON `{"error": "..."}`, sometimes with a machine-readable `code` (`ai_invalid`, `ai_unavailable`, `ai_call_limit`), `field_errors`, or `unsupported: true`.

**Drafts use optimistic locking:** every edit sends the `version` it loaded and gets `409` if the campaign changed since; a successful edit returns the campaign with its new version.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: Messages per language, review and approval

tags.name: Delivery
tags.description: Approve, cancel, resend and follow sending

post.description: Checks the email and password and sets the `scc_session` cookie. After 5 failed attempts in 15 minutes, per email and per client address, it answers `429` until the window passes.

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.

401.description: Wrong email or password (the same answer for both).

post.description: Ends the session and clears the cookie.

200.description: The marketer and the AI mode.

get.description: Rule fields with their operators and value types, the cities and categories rules may name, the validation limits and the supported languages.

get.summary: The six most relevant campaigns and the count per status
get.description: Sending first, then drafts, approved (by send time), then the rest by last change.

200.description: Campaigns and counts; `total` is the number of all campaigns.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in the brief; case and Turkish letters are folded ("isil" finds "Işıl").

200.description: One page of campaigns and the count per status.

post.description: Without `rules`, the AI turns the brief into audience rules and may propose a send time. With `rules`, the AI is skipped. A brief the AI cannot map to the catalog answers `422` with `unsupported: true`; the AI never guesses an audience.

request.example: Customers in Istanbul who added to cart in the last 7 days but didn't order

time_zone.description: IANA name; the campaign's dates are in this zone.

rules.description: Optional rules built by hand; the AI is not called.

get.description: Drafts also carry the current audience counts, the language recommendation and who would get which language.

delete.description: Drafts only; approved and later campaigns can only be cancelled.

put.description: Not for resends, whose audience is fixed.
A removed channel's text is kept and comes back with the channel, then needs review again. Not for resends.

put.summary: Turn a draft's A/B test on or off
put.description: Version B's text is kept while the test is off. Not for resends.

put.summary: Replace a draft's brief and interpret it again
put.description: The AI replaces the rules and proposed send time; the text is kept but every language needs review again. Not for resends.

put.summary: Set or clear a draft's proposed send time

send_at.description: RFC 3339 with an offset, between now and 30 days ahead; null clears it.

post.description:
Answers with server-sent events once the checks pass:

- `delta` `{"field": "en.sms.body", "text": "..."}` while the model writes
- `retry` `{"errors": ["..."]}` when the first answer is invalid and the AI tries once more
- `done` `{"content": Variants, "version": n}` after the valid text is saved
- `error` `{"message": "...", "code"?: "ai_invalid" | "ai_unavailable"}`

Only a valid answer is saved, and only while the client is still connected. Languages that already have text are rewritten only with `replace: true`.

replace.description: Rewrite languages that already have text.

variant.description: `b` writes an A/B test's version B; version A must exist in those languages.

409.description: The campaign changed, is no longer a draft, or the text exists and `replace` is false.

put.description: Sends every language the campaign keeps; languages left out are removed. A language whose text changed needs review again. Without `content_b`, version B is unchanged.

post.summary: Approve one language's text as it is
post.description: Records that the marketer reviewed it. The version is checked, not bumped. `404` if the campaign has no text in that language.

get.description: For drafts and approved campaigns; the numbers can change until sending starts.

post.description: Needs text for every chosen channel, every language approved, and a non-empty audience. Stores the estimate at approval. `send` is `"now"` or `{"at": RFC 3339}`, at least 1 minute and at most 30 days ahead.

post.summary: Cancel an approved or sending campaign
post.description: Messages still waiting are cancelled; attempts in progress finish. No request body.

post.summary: Create a resend draft for skipped recipients
post.description: For a completed or cancelled campaign: a new draft on one channel, addressed to the recipients skipped for the character limit. One active resend per channel.

get.description: Server-sent events: a `status` event with a `StatusSnapshot` at once and after each change (polled every second), then `end` `{}` when the campaign is completed or cancelled and nothing is in flight. On a server shutdown or database error the stream just closes, so `EventSource` reconnects.

200.description: The event stream; each `status` event's data is a StatusSnapshot.

get.description: 50 per page. Contacts are masked; no city, message text or provider error text is returned.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: A catalog language, or `und` for text written before languages were recorded.

200.description: One page of recipients and the counts per group.

CampaignID.name: id
CampaignID.description: Anything but a positive integer answers 404.

BadRequest.description: The body is not one JSON object of the documented shape (unknown fields are refused; at most 64 KiB, 4 KiB for login).

CrossSite.description: A write whose `Origin` is another site.

Conflict.description: The campaign changed since it was loaded, or is in a status that does not allow this.

example.error: the campaign changed since you loaded it; reload and try again

Unprocessable.description: The values are invalid; `field_errors` lists rule or content problems, `unsupported` marks a brief the AI could not map to the catalog.

AICallLimit.description: Real AI only: at most `AI_CALLS_PER_HOUR` calls per marketer in any 60 minutes.

AIFailed.description: The AI answered invalidly twice (`ai_invalid`) or could not be reached (`ai_unavailable`). Rules can still be built by hand.

AITimeout.description: The AI did not answer within `LLM_TIMEOUT`.

ServerError.description: Unexpected failure; details are logged, not returned.

unsupported.description: The brief can't be expressed with the catalog.

FieldError.description: Rule problems carry `rule` (its index; -1 for the whole list), content problems carry `field` ("en.sms.body").

Rule.description: One audience condition; a campaign's rules all must hold. `GET /api/catalog` lists each field's operators and value type.

value.description: By value type: all `true` (all_customers: every customer who allows the channel; it must be the only rule, and an empty rule list is invalid); cities `["İstanbul"]`; window `{"last_days": 7}`, `{"last_months": 3}` or `{"from": "2026-01-01", "to"?: "..."}`; count or amount a number; categories_window, amount_window and count_window are a window plus `categories`, `amount` or `count`.

Message.description: May use `{{first_name}}` and the other catalog variables.

Counts.description: Users matching the rules, in all and per channel they allowed.

OverLimit.description: Recipients whose rendered text would exceed the channel's character limit, and would be skipped.

Delivery.description: channel → language → recipients getting it in their own language or as the default.

Recommendation.description: Languages spoken by at least 5% of the audience; a suggestion only.

version.description: Send it back with every edit.

schedule_note.description: The AI's note on the time it proposed.

parent_request_text.description: In lists only: the original's brief.

approval_estimate.description: The audience and over-limit counts stored at approval.

content.description: Version A per language, including channels not chosen (kept, not sent). Single-campaign answers only.

over_limit_b.description: A/B tests with version B text only.

StatusSnapshot.description: The data of each `status` event from `/events`.

rate_limited_recent.description: 429s from the provider in the last 5 minutes.
